name: Six Seven VR
summary:
Six Seven VR is a fast-paced, meme-fueled virtual reality experience built around one simple question:

How fast can you Six Seven?

Step into VR and perform the iconic Six Seven motion as quickly and accurately as possible within a 30-second challenge. It’s easy to play, impossible to master, and strangely addictive.

Push your limits, refine your rhythm, and chase the perfect run. Whether you're warming up, competing with friends, or just embracing the absurdity, every second counts.
